Technology stocks still were hanging on to modest gain in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding over 0.3% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index also was climbing about 0.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Avalara ( AVLR ) raced as much as 13% higher on Monday after analysts at KeyBanc raised their investment call for the transaction tax-compliance software company to Overweight from Sector Weight and also setting a $47 price target for its stock.
In other sector news:
(-) Xunlei ( XNET ) was fractionally lower Monday afternoon, with shares of the cloud-based technology acceleration company unable to sustain an early 3% gain that followed a deal transferring exclusive rights to its LinkToken program outside the Chinese mainland to Beijing LinkChain Co Ltd. Moving forward, Xunlei said it will instead focus on becoming a dedicated provider of the underlying blockchain technology and infrastructure as well as leveraging its shared computing and blockchain technology for future business customers.
(+) Maxar Technologies ( MAXR ) drifted lower Monday afternoon, giving back a nearly 2% gain this morning that followed the company saying its SSL division was selected by NASA to work on two separate public-private partnerships under the space agency's Tipping Point progam. NASA considers a technology to be at a tipping point if it is likely to produce commercial space applications and also represents a significant improvement in bringing that technology to market.
(-) LivePerson ( LPSN ) was almost 3% lower shortly before Monday's closing bell, quickly giving back an early 1% gain that followed the business messaging company announcing its purchase of privately held Conversable, a conversational intelligence platform focused on social and marketing applications. Financial details of the deal were not disclosed and LivePerson said it does not expect the transaction will have a material impact on its FY18 results.
